description: This file implements the SessionServerApp class, which manages the lifecycle of a session server in a media or application management system. It includes methods for launching, configuring, and terminating session server processes, as well as socket management and internal timers for process supervision.
external_files: <system headers: algorithm, chrono, cstring, errno.h, fcntl.h, signal.h, string, sys/socket.h, sys/wait.h, unistd.h>

classes.name: SessionServerApp
classes.description: A class responsible for managing a session server process, including launching, configuration, socket communication, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Initializes sockets and spawns the session server process, waiting for child process startup confirmation.

methods.name: isPreloaded
methods.description: Returns whether the session server is preloaded.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the session server with application details if it is preloaded.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the session server is connected by verifying the status of the startup timer.

methods.name: getSessionManagementSocketName
methods.description: Returns the session management socket name.

methods.name: getSessionManagementSocketPermissions
methods.description: Returns the permissions for the session management socket.

methods.name: getClientDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the client display name.

methods.name: getInitialState
methods.description: Returns the initial session server state.

methods.name: getServerId
methods.description: Returns the unique server ID.

methods.name: getAppName
methods.description: Returns the application name.

methods.name: getAppManagementSocketName
methods.description: Returns the management socket file descriptor.

methods.name: getMaxPlaybackSessions
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of playback sessions (hardcoded to 2).

methods.name: getMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of Web Audio players (hardcoded to 1).

methods.name: cancelStartupTimer
methods.description: Cancels the startup timer if active.

methods.name: cancelStartupTimerInternal
methods.description: Internal method to cancel the startup timer with thread safety.

methods.name: addAppSuffixToLogFile
methods.description: Appends server ID suffix to log file environment variable paths.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Kills the session server process if running.

methods.name: initializeSockets
methods.description: Creates a pair of UNIX domain sockets for communication.

methods.name: setupStartupTimer
methods.description: Sets up a timer to monitor server startup and kill the process if it takes too long.

methods.name: spawnSessionServer
methods.description: Forks and executes the session server process, setting up communication sockets.

methods.name: waitForChildProcess
methods.description: Waits for the child process to exit, with a timeout to force kill if necessary.
